title: ChatGPT Reached 100 Million Users In 2 Months
hook: ChatGPT reached 100 million users in just 2 months.
closing: That adoption speed gives one company unusual influence over how millions use AI.
question: When did you first try ChatGPT?

segments.say: ChatGPT reached 900 million active users, showing the initial rush became a lasting global habit.
ChatGPT took 2 months to reach its milestone, crushing the old app-adoption timeline.
ChatGPT has 850 million free users, making mass adoption expensive to sustain.
